S02 now has a slot grid, but I haven't opened it in a browser or run it.

Choosing a day renders one pill button per slot in a 4-column grid with a 6px gap, which is the layout the original's page uses. Days with no slots still show "No open slots that day."

I matched the layout, not the original's code. The original's source has its own brand name, class names, hex color, font and a third-party widget script. I left all of those out. The buttons use our own tokens (`--accent`, `--on-accent`), so there is no raw hex, and the grid carries our class names `.slot-grid` and `.slot`.

I changed `bookly/app.js` and `bookly/styles.css`, and added F3 as done in `TICKETS.md`. Nothing is committed.

The original page only shows four static buttons. It has no hover, focus, disabled or taken states. The recon map lists those for the slot button, but I didn't add them since the page doesn't show them.
